title: S3S is the doctoral student society for Clemson University’s PhD program in Rhetorics, Communication, and Information Design.
paragraphs: The Society of the Third Sophistic fosters professionalism, collegiality, unity, and scholarly prominence among RCID students in order to encourage and strengthen academic and professional work in rhetorics, communication, and information design.

S3S is an officially recognized student organization in Clemson University’s RCID program and an officially recognized student chapter of the Rhetoric Society of America. The organization supports intellectual exchange, student-led events, resource sharing, peer advising, and community across residential and online cohorts.
This site functions both as a public-facing introduction to the organization and as a practical resource hub for current students throughout the academic year.
